notes.title: WILL: Follow The Light Shines at MIX Seattle
notes.content:
[h3]This Friday we had the pleasure of showcasing [b]WILL: Follow The Light[/b] at the [i]Media Indie Exchange[/i] in Seattle — and we want to thank everyone who stopped by! To those who watched, played our demo, and shared valuable feedback with us — your support means the world. [/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/5684ec39ae5d3622301933f3b9e3820d826f3be4.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Special thanks to the MIX organizers for the opportunity to present our game at such a wonderful event![/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/1a317141e1df9e0a378036408ef661dc3045c33d.png"][/img][/p][h3]And of course, thanks to every player around the globe for wishlisting, supporting us, and signing up for playtests — [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144860/WILL_Follow_The_Light/"]registrations are still open[/url], so don’t miss your chance to join! ⛵[/h3][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/05d95fed4ccdfe281b9e66c11655542df864f2da.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer Deep Dive — June 2025
notes.content:
[h3]Can a game move you without combat, enemies, or constant deaths? At TomorrowHead Studio, we believe it can.[/h3]

We're working to create a seamless harmony between a realistic visual style – capturing the harsh northern environment – and a deep, emotional story of a father searching for his missing son. Making a game without a HUD or objective markers is a real challenge, but that’s the goal: to make the journey as immersive and authentic as possible.

[previewyoutube=vGz5UcafG5k;full][/previewyoutube]

In our new behind-the-scenes video, our Lead Level Designer [b]Eugenia Pavlenko[/b] shares the design philosophy behind [b]WILL: Follow The Light[/b].
Watch the full video and let us know what you think – your feedback means everything to us!

notes.title: London Games Festival, here we come!
notes.content:
[h3]We are happy to announce that our game will be featured in the Official Selection of the [b]London Games Festival[/b]!

On 3 and 4 April, you will have an exclusive chance to try our demo at [b]London Museum Spaces[/b]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157952/4806cccc58aa9222d7fb84e84b3886969d291c12.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]TomorrowHead Studio[/b] is proud to present [i]WILL: Follow The Light[/i] in the NARRATIVE EXCELLENCE category along with other amazing indie games:

♦️ [i]Battle Suit Aces[/i] by [b]TrinketStudios[/b]
🎲 [i]Esoteric Ebb[/i] by [b]Chris Bodegard[/b]
🔘 [i]Button Man[/i] by [b]StyraxStudios[/b]

See you there next month, guys![/h3]
